verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you nations! Shout to God with cries of joy!
The LORD Most High is amazing. He is the great King over all the earth.
He brings nations under our control and peoples under our feet.
He chose our land for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah.
God has gone up with shouts of joy. The LORD has gone up with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
God is the King of all the earth. Sing a psalm of praise to him.
God rules over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
The leaders of the nations gather together with the people of the God of Abraham. All the rulers of the earth belong to God. He is greatly honoured!
